newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka plantations up on good growth prospects.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka plantations up on good growth prospects.

text.p: Shares of Sri Lanka's listed plantation firms were up sharply in early Friday trade on good growth expectations in 1997, brokers said.
Shares of Kelani Valley Plantations rose 4.76 percent or 1.5 rupees to 33. Bogawantalawa Plantations was 4.65 percent or two rupees up at 45.
"Plantations firms are seen doing well in 1997, due to continuing demand for Sri Lanka tea from the CIS (Commonwealth of Independent States)," said a broker who declined to be identified.
